text.arabic_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ

words.gloss_range: distal demonstrative packaging the prior discourse as the subject of a verdict
words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) points backward and turns the previous scene into a single measured subject. Its distance is not just spatial style: the prior turning-away and worldly desire from 53:29 are held at arm's length, then identified as the limit that the next word will name.

topics.headline: retrospective verdict pointer
topics.summary: The demonstrative gathers the prior discourse and makes it the subject of a nominal verdict.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins by judging the already-described posture from 53:29, not by opening an unrelated topic.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as the nominal subject, while the cross-reference points back to 53:29 as the discourse package being measured.

words.gloss_range: their reached extent or ceiling, especially in the knowledge-domain phrase
words.root_gloss_range: reaching, arriving, attaining an end, amount, and delivery; locally narrowed to a reached epistemic limit
words.prose: {{ar:مَبْلَغُهُم}} ({{tr:mablaghuhum}}) freezes the act of reaching into a noun: their knowledge has a measured ceiling. The suffix makes that ceiling belong to the class just described, while {{ar:ب ل غ}} ({{tr:b-l-gh}}) lets the endpoint image stand behind the judgment; delivery and transmission belong to the root field, but the local phrase selects reception-limit rather than prophetic delivery.

topics.headline: nominalized group ceiling
topics.summary: The mīm-masdar predicate and suffix make the prior group share one measured endpoint.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wording diagnoses a fixed group ceiling, not an ongoing attempt to know.
topics.reason: The bundle identifies the word as a mīm-masdar predicate with an attached plural possessor, so the prior package is equated with their owned extent.

topics.headline: endpoint knowledge reach
topics.summary: The broad reaching root is locally narrowed by the knowledge phrase to terminal epistemic reach.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices knowledge being pictured as a distance with an endpoint, while broader amount or delivery senses are held outside the local selection.
topics.reason: V4 allows several {{ar:ب ل غ}} ({{tr:b-l-gh}}) branches, but the following domain phrase constrains this occurrence to extent or ceiling in knowledge.

topics.headline: delivery and reception contrast
topics.summary: The delivery branch of the root remains useful as contrast, not as the selected local sense.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a root-level contrast between communication reaching people and people reaching only a limited capacity.
topics.reason: Rows about balāgh are retained as contrast because they illuminate receiver capacity, but the local form remains {{ar:مَبْلَغُهُم}} ({{tr:mablaghuhum}}), an extent noun.

topics.headline: rare marked form and sound
topics.summary: The singular mīm-masdar shape and sound texture make the ceiling wording marked.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this is not routine diction; the rare form and compact sound give the limit unusual weight.
topics.reason: The bundle marks the form as a singular mīm-masdar occurrence, and the phonetic rows connect that markedness to the constricted endpoint sense.

words.gloss_range: preposition specifying the knowledge-domain and possibly a bounded share within it
words.prose: {{ar:مِّنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) turns the prior ceiling into a ceiling in the domain of knowledge. Its force is narrowed locally to specification with partitive pressure: their reach is not knowledge itself, but a bounded share or measure within that field.

topics.headline: knowledge-domain scope
topics.summary: The preposition governs the knowledge noun and defines the scope of the measured limit.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the limit is specifically epistemic and possibly partitive, not a general limit on every capacity.
topics.reason: The particle governs the following noun, and the local phrase supports both explanatory domain-marking and bounded-share pressure without forcing only one English rendering.

words.gloss_range: definite knowledge-domain completing the opening diagnosis
words.root_gloss_range: knowing, certain recognition, teaching, informing, and sign-marking; locally the domain of genuine knowledge
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعِلْمِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿilmi}}) completes the diagnosis by naming the domain being measured. The definite singular noun makes knowledge a coherent field of real recognition and certainty, and {{ar:ع ل م}} ({{tr:ʿ-l-m}}) then becomes the ayah's thread: bounded human knowledge is answered by two divine superlatives.

topics.headline: definite knowledge domain
topics.summary: The governed definite noun presents knowledge as the field from which the prior group's reach is measured.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the critique concerns a bounded reach within knowledge as a total field.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive after the preposition and definite, making it the domain that completes the predicate complex.

topics.headline: certainty and sign field
topics.summary: The root's wider knowing, teaching, informing, and sign field is locally narrowed to genuine knowledge.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word is not counting information; it invokes the field of real recognition and certainty.
topics.reason: The broader {{ar:ع ل م}} ({{tr:ʿ-l-m}}) field informs the texture, but the local maṣdar after the preposition selects knowledge as the domain of the limit.

topics.headline: triple knowledge thread
topics.summary: The first knowledge noun starts the local root sequence completed by the two elatives.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's movement from bounded human knowledge to repeated divine knowing as a single root-thread.
topics.reason: The same root appears locally in the noun and both elative predicates, and the same-surah rows place that repetition inside a recurring knowledge polemic.

words.gloss_range: emphatic annulling particle opening the divine knowledge assertion
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) shifts the ayah from diagnosing their limited reach to asserting the Lord's knowledge with grammatical weight. It governs the next noun and, together with the following pronoun and elative, makes the divine claim the emphatic ground for the prior command and verdict; the doubled sound of the particle gives that pivot audible weight.

topics.headline: emphatic knowledge pivot
topics.summary: The particle opens the emphatic clause that answers the human knowledge ceiling.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the turn from finite human knowledge to a strengthened divine assertion.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as annulling and emphatic; attachment evidence shows it opens the clause whose subject and predicate follow.

topics.headline: causal and acoustic weight
topics.summary: The emphatic particle supplies the reasoned ground after the command scene and gives the assertion audible pressure.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the declaration is not decorative; it grounds the shift from commanded response to divine adjudication.
topics.reason: Boundary rows connect the particle to the prior command, while the phonetic row accounts for the audible weight of the emphatic entry.

words.gloss_range: your Lord, the addressed divine subject of the emphatic knowledge clause
words.root_gloss_range: lordship, ownership, governing, and nurturing to completion; locally the addressed Lord as epistemic authority
words.prose: {{ar:رَبَّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbaka}}) personalizes the knowledge claim: after their limited reach, the address turns to your Lord. The root {{ar:ر ب ب}} ({{tr:r-b-b}}) keeps Lordship as governing and sustaining authority, and the suffix makes that authority directly tied to the addressed Prophet while also anchoring the later path as His. The phrase also participates in a recurring divine-adjudication formula, here focused on who strayed and who was guided.

topics.headline: addressed Lordship shift
topics.summary: The second-person suffix shifts the discourse from their limit to your Lord.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the pronoun turn from a third-person group to the Prophet's Lord, keeping the addressee inside the assurance.
topics.reason: The attached second-person suffix is forced by the surface form and contrasts with the prior plural suffix in the opening diagnosis.

topics.headline: Lordship as knowing authority
topics.summary: The title carries ownership and nurturing authority into the knowledge assertion and the path reference.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the one who knows best is named as Lord, not as an abstract knower.
topics.reason: V4 root evidence supports ownership and nurturing authority, while contextual and attachment rows connect Lordship with knowledge and the later possessed path.

topics.headline: divine-knowledge formula
topics.summary: The phrase participates in a recurrent formula specialized here to straying and guidance.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a familiar divine adjudication formula being applied to this ayah's two categories.
topics.reason: The phrase pattern recurs in several references named by the rows, and here it is localized by the complements about straying and guidance.

words.gloss_range: independent pronoun functioning as separator and emphatic reassertion
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) slows the clause between the Lord and the superlative. It can be heard as a separating pronoun and as renewed self-reference, so the assertion becomes not merely that the Lord is knowing, but that He Himself is the one whose knowledge outranks the human limit.

topics.headline: separator exclusivity
topics.summary: The independent pronoun separates subject and predicate while reinforcing exclusive divine knowing.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the claim tightening around the divine subject before the superlative arrives.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as a pronoun of separation, and the CRITICAL rows explain its restriction and emphatic force.

topics.headline: pronoun frame architecture
topics.summary: The pronoun delays the predicate and prepares the repeated pronoun frame later in the ayah.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the audible and structural frame that will be repeated in the guided branch.
topics.reason: The independent pronoun is retained before the predicate, and later rows show the same pronoun slot repeated in the second branch.

words.gloss_range: elative predicate, most knowing or more knowing, here absolute in force over the straying class
words.root_gloss_range: knowing and certain recognition; locally intensified into an elative predicate of divine classification
words.prose: {{ar:أَعْلَمُ}} ({{tr:aʿlamu}}) is the first divine elative answer to the human knowledge limit. With no explicit comparative peer and with its bi-man complement, it reads as maximal knowing directed toward the class that strayed; {{ar:ع ل م}} ({{tr:ʿ-l-m}}) has moved from a bounded noun to divine adjudication.

topics.headline: absolute elative predicate
topics.summary: The afʿal form functions as the main predicate and carries superlative force without an explicit comparative marker.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause asserts maximal divine knowing, not a small comparison with another knower.
topics.reason: The word is an elative predicate in the emphatic clause, and the absence of a min-comparative complement supports absolute superlative force.

topics.headline: straying-class classification
topics.summary: The complement scopes the superlative toward whoever strayed.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices divine knowledge functioning as classification of the straying class, not as an abstract attribute alone.
topics.reason: The bi-man complement is syntactically governed by the elative and directs its force to the relative clause of straying.

topics.headline: knowledge thread and formula
topics.summary: The first elative echoes the knowledge noun and anticipates the repeated elative in the guided branch.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's audible escalation from limited knowledge to repeated divine superlative knowledge.
topics.reason: The same root has already appeared in the knowledge noun and will recur in the second elative; formula rows connect this construction to divine adjudication.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus relative pronoun opening the first whoever-class
words.prose: {{ar:بِمَن}} ({{tr:bi-man}}) gives the elative its object-domain and opens an unnamed whoever-class. The class is defined only when the following verb arrives, so the wording classifies by relation and action rather than by naming individuals.

topics.headline: open relative object-domain
topics.summary: The preposition plus relative pronoun scopes divine knowing toward whoever strayed and sets the parallel phrase shape.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine knowing is aimed at an open class, and the same frame will later hold the guided class.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the word the governed complement of the elative, while the relative clause supplies the open class.

words.gloss_range: he strayed, completed intransitive deviation from the path
words.root_gloss_range: straying, losing the way, error, and cognitive or moral deviation; locally path-departure rather than causative misguiding
words.prose: {{ar:ضَلَّ}} ({{tr:ḍalla}}) supplies the first classified action: a completed straying whose subject is recovered from the relative pronoun. The local Form I verb does not foreground an external misleader; {{ar:ض ل ل}} ({{tr:ḍ-l-l}}) is narrowed here into departure from a path, making error spatial, moral, and epistemic at once. The root denied of the Prophet in 53:2 now marks the strayed class, and the compact heavy sound gives the negative predicate extra weight.

topics.headline: perfect intransitive relative
topics.summary: The perfect Form I verb completes the first relative clause with the subject supplied by man.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a realized case of straying inside a relative classification, not a detached label.
topics.reason: QAC marks a perfect Form I verb, and attachment evidence recovers the subject from the relative pronoun.

topics.headline: path-departure semantics
topics.summary: The root's broad error field is locally selected as straying from the Lord's path.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices error as measurable departure from a route, while causative or purely abstract branches are not the local sense.
topics.reason: The verb takes an ʿan path complement, so the local branch is intransitive path-deviation rather than causative misguiding.

topics.headline: straying-guidance binary
topics.summary: The verb forms the negative pole that the final guidance verb will answer.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah sorting two opposed orientations under repeated divine knowledge.
topics.reason: The rows tie the root to the recurring guidance opposition and to the later matching verb slot.

topics.headline: surah echo and sound
topics.summary: The root contrasts with the Prophet's non-straying in 53:2 and carries compact negative sound.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same root denied of the Prophet in 53:2 is now used for the class known as strayed.
topics.reason: The same-surah echo is explicit in the rows, and the phonetic rows preserve the compact sound-pressure of the negative predicate.

words.gloss_range: preposition of separation marking the path departed from
words.prose: {{ar:عَن}} ({{tr:ʿan}}) prevents straying from floating as an absolute label. It marks separation from the path, so the error is measured against a route-standard and carries forward the departure pattern already heard in 53:29.

topics.headline: separation from standard
topics.summary: The preposition links the straying verb to the path as the reference standard departed from.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that straying is defined by separation from a standard, not merely by wandering.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the following path the governed complement, and the local verb selects the separation sense of the preposition.

words.gloss_range: His path, the possessed route-standard from which straying is measured
words.root_gloss_range: path, way, course, extended route, and flow imagery; locally the Lord's singular path
words.prose: {{ar:سَبِيلِهِۦ}} ({{tr:sabīlihi}}) gives the straying a standard: it is departure from His path. The suffix most directly returns to the Lord, and {{ar:س ب ل}} ({{tr:s-b-l}}) contributes a continuous route image, narrowed here to a singular owned way rather than a set of routes or a free physical-flow branch. That route image also prepares the final guidance verb, so the path becomes the axis between departure and right orientation.

topics.headline: possessed path standard
topics.summary: The suffix makes the path definite and ties it to the Lord as the standard from which straying occurs.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the route-standard belongs to the Lord, not to an impersonal moral scale.
topics.reason: The attached suffix makes the noun possessed, and attachment evidence points most directly back to the Lord as antecedent.

topics.headline: continuous route image
topics.summary: The broader path and flow field is locally narrowed to a singular moral route.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the path as an extended way one can depart from, while plural routes and physical flow remain background texture.
topics.reason: V4 supports wider path and flow imagery, but the singular construct possessed noun selects the local route-standard sense.

topics.headline: path-guidance bridge
topics.summary: The path phrase closes the negative clause and anticipates the final guidance verb.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the path is the axis connecting the straying branch to the guided branch.
topics.reason: Rows connect s-b-l with both straying and guidance, and the clause evidence shows the path phrase sealing the first relative clause before the guided branch.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction linking the second knowledge clause to the first
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the hinge that keeps the guided branch coordinated with the straying branch. It adds the second clause while carrying contrast, so the ayah forms a balanced taxonomy rather than a sequence of unrelated statements.

topics.headline: coordinated binary hinge
topics.summary: The conjunction binds the two aʿlamu clauses into a balanced pair and keeps the second branch within the emphatic frame or as a renewed parallel.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that straying and guidance are paired under one coordinated divine-knowledge structure.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a conjunction, and attachment evidence connects the second clause to the first with strong parallelism.

words.gloss_range: renewed independent pronoun in the second parallel clause
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) restarts the subject-predicate architecture for the guided branch. The repetition renews the same divine subject and gives the positive branch equal structural weight, rather than letting it trail as an abbreviated add-on.

topics.headline: renewed divine subject
topics.summary: The second pronoun resumes or repeats the separator function and keeps the guided branch tied to the same divine subject.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the guided class is also placed under exclusive divine knowing.
topics.reason: The pronoun begins the coordinated clause and can either resume the subject or renew the separator role without changing the divine subject.

topics.headline: mirrored pronoun frame
topics.summary: The repeated pronoun mirrors word 7 and delays the second elative with equal cadence.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the second branch being re-performed with the same pronoun frame as the first.
topics.reason: Rows identify the repetition of the independent pronoun before both elatives and its role in preserving symmetry.

words.gloss_range: repeated elative predicate applying divine knowing to the guided class
words.root_gloss_range: knowing and certain recognition; locally repeated as superlative divine knowledge over guidance
words.prose: {{ar:أَعْلَمُ}} ({{tr:aʿlamu}}) repeats the same elative instead of leaving the positive branch elliptical. That repetition gives the guided class full parity with the straying class under {{ar:ع ل م}} ({{tr:ʿ-l-m}}), and it carries the ayah toward a final landing on guidance.

topics.headline: repeated predicate parity
topics.summary: The second elative is repeated rather than omitted, giving the guided branch its own explicit superlative predicate.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guidance is known with the same explicit superlative force as straying.
topics.reason: The second branch repeats the same elative form and is coordinated with the first superlative clause.

topics.headline: guided class known
topics.summary: The complement and final verb scope the second elative toward whoever is guided.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices guidance as a precisely known status, not merely the positive opposite of error.
topics.reason: The second bi-man complement is governed by the elative and completed by the guided verb.

topics.headline: knowledge thread closure
topics.summary: The third local occurrence of the knowledge root completes the ayah's root arc before the final verb.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices bounded human knowledge surrounded and surpassed by repeated divine knowing.
topics.reason: The local sequence moves from the knowledge noun to two elatives, and the second elative closes that root-thread before the final guidance verb.

words.gloss_range: second preposition-plus-relative phrase, with liaison kasra before the final verb
words.prose: {{ar:بِمَنِ}} ({{tr:bi-mani}}) repeats the preposition-plus-relative frame for the guided branch. Its added kasra is not semantic by itself, but it matters in realization: the open class and final verb are bound together smoothly in recitation while preserving phrase-shape symmetry with the earlier bi-man.

topics.headline: guided relative frame
topics.summary: The second bi-man phrase gives the guided branch the same object-domain structure as the strayed branch.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that only the verbs carry the opposition because the grammatical frame is repeated.
topics.reason: The word is governed by the second elative and introduces the relative class completed by the final verb.

topics.headline: liaison kasra
topics.summary: The final kasra prepares the transition into the following waṣl-hamza and fuses the phrase audibly.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the repeated frame is not mechanically identical; recitation adapts it to flow into the final verb.
topics.reason: Rows identify the kasra as liaison before the following waṣl-hamza, preserving the syntactic unit in sound.

words.gloss_range: he was guided, found right orientation, or attained guidance; locally the achieved guided state
words.root_gloss_range: guiding, showing the way, right direction, and guided status; locally Form VIII self-involving attainment of guidance
words.prose: {{ar:ٱهْتَدَىٰ}} ({{tr:ihtadā}}) closes the ayah with the guided category. Its Form VIII shape makes guidance a self-involving attained state under divine knowledge, not a simple active guiding verb; {{ar:ه د ي}} ({{tr:h-d-y}}) answers the earlier straying branch and lets the final sound and sense land on guidance. Within the surah, guidance that came in 53:23 is now seen as guidance attained by a person known to the Lord.

topics.headline: Form VIII guided state
topics.summary: The final perfect Form VIII verb classifies the relative subject as one who has attained guidance.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices guidance as an achieved, self-involving orientation, while simple active guiding or passive reception is not the local form.
topics.reason: QAC marks the verb as perfect Form VIII and intransitive; the local form differs from both simple hadā and passive hudiya.

topics.headline: guidance positive pole
topics.summary: The final verb supplies the positive evaluative pole opposite straying.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the taxonomy ending on successful route-orientation rather than on the negative branch.
topics.reason: The guidance verb occupies the matched final slot opposite the straying verb and completes the ayah's two-branch classification.

topics.headline: surah guidance echo
topics.summary: The final verb echoes guidance language from 53:23 and ties guidance to Lordship and knowledge.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a shift from guidance arriving in 53:23 to the person who has attained guidance in 53:30.
topics.reason: Rows explicitly connect this final verb with 53:23 and with the recurring h-d-y versus ḍ-l-l axis.

topics.headline: final guidance landing
topics.summary: The word seals the second relative clause and gives the ayah its final semantic and acoustic landing.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah's last position belongs to guidance, both semantically and recitationally.
topics.reason: The final verb completes the second relative clause and the long final vowel rows preserve the acoustic closure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مبلغهم من العلم; ربك هو أعلم; ضل عن سبيله / اهتدى
baseline_models.mechanism: A finite human reach is set against authoritative knowing that discriminates two trajectories relative to one way. Endpoint, disclosure, lordship, deviation, route, and gentle direction form an epistemic-jurisdiction model.

activation_trace.role: Reaching a measured endpoint makes مبلغهم the terminating horizon of human knowledge.
Knowledge as disclosure contrasts their bounded apprehension with the repeated divine أعلم.
Lordship, ownership, and authority ground the asymmetry in who can judge the route.
Deviation from aim supplies one trajectory that finite observers cannot finally classify.
The extended traversed way gives deviation and guidance a shared spatial field.
Gentle direction toward way or truth supplies the counter-trajectory to deviation.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely says that they know little and God knows more.
changed_reading.after: Their knowing terminates at a horizon inside which they cannot reliably classify a person's route; the Lord's knowing alone spans deviation and guidance.

baseline_models.mechanism: Knowledge can be a distinguishing landmark, the way an extended route, straying disappearance from view, and guidance an intended course. The focus therefore supports a wayfinding model in which a sign-system loses the traveler but divine knowing does not.

activation_trace.role: A visible distinguishing mark recasts knowledge as the landmarks by which a route is read.
Hiddenness or disappearance makes straying also a loss from the observer's field.
A traversed route organizes the marks, disappearance, and recovered direction into one mechanism.
Course and intended direction make guidance an orientation, not merely a possessed proposition.
The reached limit marks where the human map ceases to orient reliably.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge is an abstract quantity and straying is only a moral label.
changed_reading.after: Knowledge is a finite sign-system; God can locate trajectories that have moved beyond or vanished from its markers.

baseline_models.mechanism: مبلغ can name sufficient provision by which one gets by. Joined to knowledge as disclosure, this distinguishes a usable epistemic ration from exhaustive truth without yet resolving what ذلك points to.

activation_trace.role: Sufficient provision turns مبلغ into the ration that sustains a limited practice or life.
Disclosure supplies the epistemic substance whose sufficiency is being questioned.

changed_reading.before: مبلغ names only a quantitative ceiling on knowledge.
changed_reading.after: Their knowledge may be just enough to sustain a chosen mode of life, precisely because practical utility is not exhaustive truth.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مبلغهم; ربك; ضل عن سبيله; اهتدى
baseline_models.mechanism: Reaching an endpoint or maturity, nurture stage by stage, the split target's nourishment and growth, and guidance as course make the two path states developmental trajectories under the Lord's full care.

activation_trace.role: Arrival and maturity make مبلغ a developmental reach rather than a frozen amount.
Repair, nurture, and completion make the Lord the knower of formation stage by stage.
The non-dominant mapped image of nourishment and growing up intensifies the developmental mechanism.
Departure from aim supplies a trajectory that can bend during formation.
Course, conduct, and intended direction make guidedness an unfolding orientation.

changed_reading.before: Astray and guided are two static classes already visible to observers.
changed_reading.after: They are formed trajectories of growth, care, direction, and deviation whose full histories are known by the nurturing Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context distinguishes authorized orientation from counterfeit sign-making: a prominent marker, distant horizon, visible signs, names as indications or brands, and absent compelling proof. This activates the focus علم as a waymark and makes divine knowing independent of socially installed labels.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark turns the focus knowledge into the marker-system being tested.
The traversed way supplies the route on which valid or counterfeit markers orient people.
A prominent landmark at the opening externalizes knowledge as a visible orientation signal.
Distant horizons spatialize the finite reach implicit in مبلغ.
A visible sign supplies the positive case of evidence that can genuinely orient.
A name as indication shows how a label can function as a pointing sign.
The split target's visible branding shows how naming can manufacture recognizability without reality.
Compelling proof supplies the authorization explicitly missing from the manufactured names.

structural_cues: 53:1-18 moves through star, horizon, sight, and signs before 53:23 turns to unsupported names.
The focus then repeats knowledge language inside a path contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies landmark, horizon, sign, name, brand, and compelling-proof images; I infer that signs orient the focus سبيل and unsupported marks counterfeit orientation; alternatively the naming passage may only expose false attribution without building a navigation model.

changed_reading.before: Their knowledge fails because it contains too few facts.
changed_reading.after: Their knowledge may be a misauthorized map: labels look like waymarks, but only divine knowing distinguishes the real route from its socially branded substitutes.

context_deltas.mechanism: مبلغ becomes the reach of a transmission chain. Speech issuing from inclination contrasts with knowledge cast covertly and taught; the decisive deficit is provenance, not volume.

activation_trace.role: Conveying a message turns مبلغ into the reach achieved by a channel of transmission.
Knowledge as disclosure is the content whose source and reach are contrasted.
Articulated speech supplies the observable output whose provenance must be tested.
Inclination of the self supplies one possible source-vector for speech.
Knowledge cast in hidden fashion supplies the contrasting transmission source.
Teaching makes reception and formation of knowledge explicit rather than self-generated.

structural_cues: 53:3-5 orders speech, negated inclination, hidden communication, and teaching as a source sequence.
53:30 contrasts their علم with the Lord's repeated أعلم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speech, inclination, covert imparting, teaching, and message-reaching images; I infer that source controls epistemic reach; alternatively the earlier sequence may distinguish prophetic speech without defining every later human knowledge claim.

changed_reading.before: The human-divine contrast is a simple difference in how much each knows.
changed_reading.after: The contrast also concerns where knowing comes from and how far its transmission remains trustworthy: inclination-fed speech bottoms out where imparted and taught disclosure does not.

context_deltas.mechanism: Straight completion, inward sight, non-inclination, non-overrun, and composed bearing turn the focus path contrast into an embodied epistemic calibration. Guidance can be steadiness of perception and conduct, not merely a correct proposition.

activation_trace.role: Deviation from aim is the loss of calibration that the contextual poles specify.
The traversed way gives calibration a course on which it can hold or fail.
Calm stillness and composed bearing make guidedness an embodied stability.
Straightness and completion establish the positive calibration pole.
Inclining away from straightness supplies lateral perceptual drift.
Insight of the heart extends calibration beyond bare eyesight into discernment.
Crossing the limit in rebellion supplies the opposite failure of overrun.

structural_cues: 53:6 presents straight completion before 53:17 denies both visual inclination and excess.
53:30 later names deviation from a way and attained guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies straightness, inward sight, inclination, limit-crossing, and composed-bearing images; I infer that visual discipline models epistemic and ethical method; alternatively 53:17 may describe one vision without generalizing its calibration to 53:30.

changed_reading.before: Guidance means holding the right information and straying means holding the wrong information.
changed_reading.after: Guidance can be a calibrated bearing that neither drifts nor overruns, while finite knowledge fails when perception and conduct lose that balance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Inclination supplies force, following tracks supplies motion, conjecture supplies an unreliable trail, and will selects the lower destination. The human knowledge horizon is therefore desire-shaped and self-sealing rather than a neutral shortage.

activation_trace.role: The reached endpoint becomes the result of a motivated route rather than an accidental ceiling.
Deviation from aim names the trajectory produced by the contextual motive and method.
The extended route holds the sequence of inclination, tracking, and arrival together.
The self's inclination supplies the directional force behind selective knowing.
Tracing one mark after another supplies the method by which conjecture becomes a followed path.
Doubt and imagining supply the unstable evidence being treated as a trail.
Reality fixed against falsehood supplies the criterion that conjecture cannot alter.
Will and intention expose the selected destination behind the epistemic route.
The lower and nearer world supplies the destination at which this knowledge elects to stop.

structural_cues: 53:23 and 53:28 repeat following conjecture, with desire named in 53:23.
53:29 immediately joins turning away from remembrance to willing only the lower life before 53:30 says ذلك مبلغهم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inclination, track-following, imagined evidence, fixed reality, will, and the lower destination; I infer the causal arrow desire to selective following to bounded knowledge; alternatively these may be adjacent moral failures without one producing the other.

changed_reading.before: They stop knowing because evidence is unavailable to them.
changed_reading.after: They stop where their desire-led method takes them: conjecture traces a route toward the lower aim, so the epistemic boundary is partly chosen and maintained.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus provision branch joins contextual sufficiency, beneficial life, and the lower world. Their knowledge can function well enough as subsistence for worldly aims while remaining unable to avail against truth.

activation_trace.role: Provision by which one gets by makes knowledge a ration calibrated to a limited life.
Knowledge as disclosure is the ration whose practical sufficiency is separated from truth.
Sufficiency activates the distinction between what gets by and what cannot substitute for truth.
Life as benefit and good supplies the practical economy served by the ration.
The lower world restricts the economy to its near-term horizon.

structural_cues: 53:28 denies that conjecture has any sufficiency against truth.
53:29 names only the lower life immediately before the deictic ذلك in 53:30.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies provision, sufficiency, useful life, and lower-world images; I infer that ذلك reaches at least the immediately preceding lower-life orientation and that its knowledge is operationally adequate to it; alternatively the demonstrative may summarize a broader passage.

changed_reading.before: Their knowledge is simply too small to be useful.
changed_reading.after: It may be useful in a narrow sense: a ration sufficient for lower-life aims, yet categorically unable to nourish judgment beyond that economy.

context_deltas.mechanism: Matched recompense, intentional action, upbringing, concealed embryonic formation, growth or purification, and self-protection make divine route-knowledge longitudinal. The Lord knows how a person was formed and moved, not merely which label the person claims now.

activation_trace.role: Arrival and maturity make the focus limit one stage in a longer formation.
Nurture and completion make lordly knowing continuous with formation and care.
The split target's nourishment and growing up keeps developmental increase live beside lordship.
Course and conduct make attained guidance the outcome of a lived trajectory.
Matching an act with its consequence turns divine knowing into accountable discrimination.
Intentional action supplies the observable movement whose route is judged.
A youth's growth and upbringing extend judgment backward through formation.
The embryo hidden in the belly supplies a stage inaccessible to self-report and public labels.
Growth and increase make self-purification a claim about development, not a fixed badge.
Purity and rectitude supply the claimed moral state that divine knowing, not self-certification, assesses.
Placing oneself under protection gives piety a practiced orientation rather than a title.

structural_cues: 53:31 follows the focus with recompense according to deeds.
53:32 runs from earthly and embryonic origin through the ban on self-purification to God's knowledge of the self-protecting person.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matched consequence, action, upbringing, concealed embryo, growth or purity, and self-protection; I infer that the focus classifications summarize whole trajectories; alternatively 53:31-32 may separately stress omniscience and ethics without redefining guidedness developmentally.

changed_reading.before: God knows which already formed category each person occupies.
changed_reading.after: God knows the hidden formation, practiced direction, and accountable consequences by which each trajectory becomes stray or guided, defeating self-awarded status.

context_deltas.mechanism: A digger stopped by hard ground, the unseen hidden from eyes, and the claim to see turn مبلغ into epistemic depth. Human inquiry can halt at a resistant stratum and then mistake the stopping point for sight of what lies beyond.

activation_trace.role: Reaching a limit supplies the depth at which inquiry stops.
Disclosure names what the halted inquiry has and has not uncovered.
Hiddenness keeps the unexposed trajectory below the observer's accessible surface.
Hard ground that stops digging supplies the material model for an epistemic boundary.
What is screened from eyes supplies the content lying beyond the reached stratum.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies the challenged claim that the hidden layer is nevertheless visible.

structural_cues: 53:33-34 depicts turning away, giving little, and stopping at كدى.
53:35 immediately asks whether the person possesses unseen knowledge and therefore sees.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stopped excavation, hiddenness, unseen content, and seeing; I infer a material arrow from striking bedrock to mistaking limited exposure for total vision; alternatively كدى may characterize only interrupted giving, with no epistemic analogy.

changed_reading.before: The boundary of their knowledge is an abstract line.
changed_reading.after: It can be read as epistemic bedrock: inquiry reaches a hard stop, while the Lord still knows the hidden route beneath what human sight can expose.

context_deltas.mechanism: Purposeful movement is shown, matched with consequence, completed without deficit, and brought to the Lord's ultimate endpoint. The focus's human knowledge-limit is nested inside a teleological route whose full course and outcome divine knowing spans.

activation_trace.role: The human reached limit becomes a provisional endpoint inside a longer course.
The extended traversed way supplies the course along which effort and outcome unfold.
Intended direction makes guidedness the orientation of purposeful movement.
Intentional movement toward a sought end supplies the person's actual route contribution.
Showing and making visible moves the route from hidden effort into disclosed evidence.
Matching action with consequence connects direction to outcome.
Completion without deficit supplies the full accounting unavailable at the human horizon.
Lordship and authority identify the possessor of the final endpoint.
The goal at which a thing ends supplies the ultimate terminus beyond their مبلغ.
A number's measured extent echoes مبلغ as an amount nested within the final limit.

structural_cues: 53:39-41 orders striving, its future disclosure, and complete recompense.
53:42 closes the sequence with the endpoint to your Lord, echoing the focus's ربك and مبلغ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies purposeful motion, disclosure, matched consequence, full completion, lordship, and endpoint; I infer the arrow from lived striving to revealed and completed route-outcome; alternatively the sequence may state accountability without specifying how guidance develops.

changed_reading.before: Straying or guidance is a verdict detached from what a person does over time.
changed_reading.after: It is a directed course embodied in striving, later exposed and fully answered at the Lord's endpoint; the human knowledge-limit is only an intermediate stopping place.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant split target attached to ه د ي, whose branch concerns an unconfirmed suspicion rather than guidance. It remains live because that exact mapped branch is packet-authorized at focus اهتدى and explicit conjecture recurs nearby; downstream prose must present only a speculative contrast between actual guidance and felt certainty, never this branch as the lexical meaning of اهتدى.

activation_trace.role: The split target's unconfirmed inward suspicion opens a gap between attained guidance and merely seeming guided to oneself.
The same split image at the earlier arrival of الهدى keeps the activation attached to the surah's guidance lexeme.
Doubt and imagining provide an explicit nearby analogue for felt certainty without verification.

changed_reading.before: The final contrast transparently separates the astray from the genuinely guided.
changed_reading.after: Divine knowing may also expose the gap between being guided and merely carrying an unconfirmed inward picture that one is guided.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain material model built from several odd but exact focus branches. It remains anchored in العلم, ربك, سبيله, and مبلغ and coherently contrasts local storage with distributed nurture; downstream prose must qualify it as hydrological analogy, not substitute water, cloud, or rain for the focus lexemes.

activation_trace.role: A large gathered body of water materializes human knowledge as bounded storage.
A low persistent cloud supplies an overhead source for the nurture implicit in Lordship.
Abundant collected water expands lordly supply beyond the local reservoir.
Falling rain turns the way into a material distribution channel within the analogy.
Sufficient provision gives the bounded reservoir its subsistence function.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge is an abstract stock measured only by quantity.
changed_reading.after: Their knowledge can be imagined as a local reservoir that lets them get by, while divine knowing belongs to a wider cloud-rain economy feeding routes beyond their stored supply.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The horseman image is an idiomatic, branch-distant activation under ب ل غ, so the reading is deliberately kinetic rather than lexical. It remains anchored by focus route and direction branches and by contextual rapid travel plus desire; downstream prose should render it as an exploratory analogy for acceleration without orientation.

activation_trace.role: A horseman extending the reins to increase speed makes epistemic reach a possible accelerator.
The traversed route determines where the accelerated motion actually goes.
Intended direction distinguishes speed from genuine orientation.
Rapid forward travel activates the kinetic side of the reins image.
Inclination of the self supplies the desire-selected vector along which speed can mislead.

changed_reading.before: Greater epistemic reach necessarily moves a person closer to guidance.
changed_reading.after: Finite knowledge can act like reins that increase speed along a desire-selected route, so epistemic reach may intensify rather than cure straying.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because ضل is normally carried as moral or path deviation, while its focus inventory also permits disappearance. Concealed embryo, hidden interior, and unseen content keep the overlay contextually anchored; downstream prose should retain moral deviation as the primary coexistive reading while noting that God knows route-histories lost to human sight.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: بمن ضل عن سبيله beside أعلم

activation_trace.role: Disappearance or absorption lets the straying trajectory become inaccessible to human observation.
Knowledge as disclosure makes divine awareness span what has disappeared from view.
The embryo concealed in the belly supplies a route-history hidden from public classification.
The concealed interior broadens hiddenness from location to inward history.
What is screened from eyes confirms the limit of human access to the disappeared trajectory.

changed_reading.before: Who strayed is a fully visible moral class that observers can identify from the outside.
changed_reading.after: Alongside moral deviation, straying can carry a hidden-history overlay: God knows trajectories that have disappeared into interiors and origins inaccessible to human sight.

strongest_changes: The finite knowledge-limit became desire-shaped and provenance-sensitive rather than merely quantitative.
Names and visible marks became a counterfeit wayfinding system unless authorized by compelling proof.
Divine knowledge of straying and guidance became longitudinal, spanning hidden formation, practiced effort, disclosed outcome, and the final endpoint.
مبلغ retained coexisting material readings as practical ration and epistemic bedrock, with acceleration, hydrology, and split-root suspicion preserved as contained outliers.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots first formed a coherent horizon-and-navigation field; context then changed its causal structure through transmission, motive, formation, accountability, and teleology without collapsing the provision, material, or split-root activations.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact reach of the demonstrative ذلك remains open even though adjacency strongly activates the lower-life reading.
The bedrock, hydrology, and reins models are branch-grounded analogies, not secure lexical substitutions.
The non-dominant ه د د and ر ب و targets remain formally distant and require explicit containment.
Hiddenness can coexist with moral deviation in ضل, but should not erase the primary route-error sense.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Knowledge stopped at its reached limit.** ب ل غ B001 supplies reaching an endpoint; ع ل م B001 knowledge. The partitive construction makes worldly desire in 53:29 the ceiling of their cognition. I infer that chosen orientation limits what can be known; the ayah reads as a diagnosis of epistemic range, not a neutral quantity.
2. **A marker that fails to reach the route.** ع ل م B002 supplies distinguishing marks; س ب ل B001 an extended traversed way; ض ل ل B001 deviation; ه د ي B001 guidance. I infer that their available signs do not connect into the route of guidance, whereas divine knowledge distinguishes both trajectories. The ayah reads as failed wayfinding.
3. **Lordly knowledge is formative, not merely observational.** ر ب ب B002 supplies nurture and staged completion; ه د ي B001 includes divine enabling. I infer that the one who forms and sustains trajectories knows them in a way bounded agents do not. The repeated *aʿlamu* reads as knowledge grounded in governance.
4. **The “limit” may be sufficient provision, but only for their chosen world.** ب ل غ B003 supplies provision by which one gets by. Exploratorily, I infer that their knowledge suffices for proximate life while failing beyond it. This preserves a practical adequacy reading without upgrading it to truth.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 53:35 exposes a human claim to unseen knowledge, and 53:40 later makes endeavor visible. Those ayat confirm that the divine comparative knowledge here spans both concealed trajectory and eventual disclosure, beyond the agents' ب ل غ B001 limit.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Desire fixes a horizon at which knowledge stops.** `ب ل غ B001` supplies reaching a limit, `ع ل م B001` supplies clear knowing, `س ب ل B001` supplies an extended traversed way, `ض ل ل B001` supplies departure from aim, and `ه د ي B001` supplies gentle guidance toward a way. The preceding choice of only near life explains the demonstrative “that,” while the path pair converts knowledge into route awareness. The packet supplies a selected near object, a knowledge limit, and divergent paths; I infer the arrow narrowed desire -> shortened epistemic horizon -> route error. The fixed ayah reads as a spatial model of cognition rather than a statement about low information quantity alone.

2. **Nurturing knowledge exceeds self-certified limits.** `ر ب ب B002` supplies nurture and completion, and the repeated comparative `أعلم` surrounds both deviation and guidance. The nearby warning against self-purification in 53:32 and the claimed hidden knowledge in 53:35 show why the subject cannot assess its own endpoint. The packet supplies comprehensive knowledge and later failed self-assessment; I infer the arrow complete developmental knowledge -> superior path judgment. The ayah reads `ربك` as the knower of trajectories because the same relation oversees their formation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - Later 53:31-35 filled the knowledge horizon with act-matched accounting, hidden origin, visible behavior, and a failed claim to unseen knowledge.

baseline.text: Onların bilgiden ulaştığı son nokta budur. Rabbin, yolundan sapanı da doğru yolu bulanı da en iyi bilir.

findings.text: Yalnız yakın hayatı isteyen arzu, bilginin durduğu ufku kısaltır ve yol ayrımını yanlış görmeye yol açar.
Eldeki işaretlerin birleşip bir güzergâh oluşturmaması, insanın yön bulma araçlarıyla ilahi yol bilgisinin farkını gösterir.
Rabbin yolcuları yetiştirip tamamlayan oluşu, iki güzergâhı yalnız gözlemle değil onların gelişimini yöneterek bilmesini açıklar.
Sınırlı bilgi yakın hayatı sürdürmeye yetecek bir azık olabilir, fakat bu pratik yeterlilik onu daha geniş gerçeklik için yeterli kılmaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi temel olarak bir yere, şeye veya belirlenmiş son sınıra ulaşmayı anlatır. Bununla birlikte kullanım yalnızca gerçekleşmiş varışı kapsamaz; kimi bağlamlarda sınıra yaklaşmayı ve bir çocuğun olgunluk çağına erişmesini de içerir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği ulaşmadır; yaklaşma ve olgunlaşma, belirli bağlamlara bağlı ayrı uzanımlardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel ulaşma çekirdeğiyle kalıp yer, süre, belirlenmiş sınır, yaklaşma ve olgunlaşma kalıplarını birbirine karıştırmadan ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir yere ya da şeye ulaşmak veya bir zamanın, işin ya da önceden belirlenmiş ölçünün son sınırına varmak. Bazı kalıplarda o sınıra yaklaşmayı ya da bir çocuğun olgunluk çağına erişmesini anlatır.

facets.statement: Bir yere veya şeye erişip varma temel anlamdır.
Bir zamanın, işin veya belirlenmiş ölçünün en son sınırına varmayı da kapsar.
Kimi kullanımlarda son sınıra gerçekten varmak yerine ona iyice yaklaşmak anlatılır.
Çocuk için kullanıldığında bedensel olgunluk çağına erişmeyi belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, yer veya nesneye erişme ile bir süreç ya da ölçünün sonuna varma çekirdeğinde birleşir; yaklaşma ve çocuğun olgunlaşması bu çekirdeğin bağlama bağlı uzanımlarıdır.

concept_gloss.text: bir yere, şeye veya son sınıra ulaşma; bağlama göre yaklaşma ya da olgunluğa erme

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi ve özellikle bir iletiyi alıcısına ulaştırma veya ulaşmasını sağlama anlamını doğrudan destekler. Bu işlem, kişinin kendisinin bir yere varmasından ve söz söyleme niteliğinden ayrıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği aktarılacak şeyi hedefe ulaştırmaktır; yalnızca kişinin kendi varışı bu dala girmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, yaşamı sürdürmeye yetecek miktarı veya aracı ve kişinin elindekiyle yetinmesini birlikte destekler. Buradaki yeterlik, ileti ulaştırmaktan ayrı bir geçim ve yetme alanıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yaşamı sürdürmeye yetecek ölçü ve araçla sınırlıdır; bolluk veya kazanç edinme süreci değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yeterlik bildiren adlar ile eldeki geçim aracıyla yetinme kalıbı ayrıştırılır; kalıp yalın köke genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir konuda yeterli olma veya ihtiyacı karşılayacak ölçüde bulunma. Geçimlik, yiyecek ya da azık ve eldekiyle yetinme bu genel yeterlik çekirdeğinin özel kullanımlarıdır.

facets.statement: Bir konuda veya gereksinim karşısında yeterli olma temel anlamdır.
Yiyecek, azık ve öteki geçim araçları somut yeterlik biçimleridir.
Kişi elindeki yeterli şeyle yetinir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yeterli ölçü, yaşamı sürdüren yiyecek veya geçim aracı ve bunlarla yetinme kullanımlarını aynı geçim çekirdeği altında toplar.

concept_gloss.text: yaşamı sürdürmeye yetecek ölçü ve geçim aracı
concept_gloss.applicability: Hem soyut yeterlik ölçüsünü hem de yiyecek gibi somut geçim aracını kapsar; yetinme kullanımı bu çekirdeğe bağlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kişi anlatmak istediğini açık ve etkili biçimde dile getirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kişi söz, düşünce veya kanıt bakımından kendini anlatamaz ve yanıt üretmekte tıkanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal, kişinin sözle kendini anlatabilme gücü ekseninin karşı yönlerini gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı anlatımın amacına ulaşan güçlü kutbudur; komşu dal aynı yetinin işlemediği veya belirgin biçimde zayıfladığı kutuptur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm adaylar değerlendirildi; dil ustalığı, düzgün konuşma ve anlatım yetersizliğiyle olan üç belirleyici sınır yayımlandı.

branches.source_phrase_ar: البلاغة التي يمدح بها الفصيح اللسان لأنه يبلغ بها ما يريده (maqayis)؛ رجل بلغ بليغ وقد بلغ بلاغة (ayn)؛ كلام بلغ وبليغ؛ بلغ الرجل بلاغة إذا صار بليغا (jamhara)؛ البلاغة الفصاحة؛ بلغ الرجل أي صار بليغا (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnızca yüksek kaliteyi değil, bir işte bütün gücü kullanıp eksik bırakmamayı ve pekiştirmenin son sınırına varmasını da kapsar. Bu nedenle dal, kalite başlığıyla sınırlanmayıp bir niteliği, işi veya pekiştirmeyi erişilebilecek en ileri dereceye götürme çevresinde yeniden kurulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yüksek kalite bu dalın yalnızca bir görünümüdür; çekirdek, ilgili ölçekte en ileri dereceye erişmedir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yüksek nitelikli şey, çabada eksik bırakmama ve son derecedeki pekiştirme ayrı kalıplar olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir niteliği, işi veya pekiştirmeyi ulaşılabilecek en ileri dereceye götürmek ya da o derecede olmak. Yüksek nitelik, bütün gücü kullanarak eksik bırakmama ve en güçlü pekiştirme bunun ayrı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir ölçekte ulaşılabilecek en ileri dereceye erişme ortak anlam çekirdeğidir.
Bir şey nitelik bakımından çok iyi ve yetkin bir dereceye ulaşmış olabilir.
Bir işi yapan kişi bütün gücünü kullanır ve işi eksik bırakmaz.
Bir buyruk veya ant, tamamlanma ya da pekiştirme bakımından son dereceye ulaşır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak anlatımı, yüksek nitelik, tüm gücü kullanarak eksik bırakmama ve tamamlanmış pekiştirme kullanımlarını bir derecenin sonuna erişme ortaklığında birleştirir.

concept_gloss.text: bir şeyi ulaşılabilir en ileri dereceye götürme
concept_gloss.applicability: Nitelik, çaba ve pekiştirme alanlarının her birinde ortak olan son dereceye erişme yapısını temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: En ileri dereceyi, yetkin niteliği, eksik bırakmayan çabayı ve güçlü pekiştirmeyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir niteliğin veya eylemin ilgili ölçekte ulaşılabilecek en ileri düzeye götürülmesi bağlamına uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ölçekteki en ileri dereceye erişme çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin kalite bakımından ileri ve tamamlanmış bir düzeyde olduğunu belirtir.

error_profile.preserves: Yüksek ve tamamlanmış nitelik değerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin bir işte bütün çabasını kullanıp hiçbir yanı eksik bırakmaması bağlamına uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bütün gücü kullanma ve eksik bırakmama koşullarını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: eksiksiz buyruk veya en güçlü biçimde pekiştirilmiş ant

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Çabayı eksik bırakmamayı ve bir pekiştirmeyi son dereceye götürmeyi de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyin iyi, düzgün veya işe yarar olmasını ve onu bu duruma getirmeyi genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir şeyin yüksek nitelikte olması iki dalın ortak bölgesidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı kaliteyi son dereceye erişme görünümüyle ve başka derece kullanımlarıyla birlikte kurar; komşu dalın çekirdeği doğrudan iyi ve düzgün olmadır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bütün gücü kullanma ve pekiştirmeyi en ileri dereceye çıkarma değerlerini taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyin parçalarının tamamlanmasını, eksiğinin kalmamasını ve bütünlenmesini genel olarak anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da bir ölçünün sonuna erişme ve eksik bırakmama düşüncesi vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı derece ve yoğunluk eksenindedir; komşu dal ise bir bütünün tamamlanması ve gereken parçaların yerine gelmesi eksenindedir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İş çabası ve pekiştirme gibi kalite dışı alanlarda da en ileri dereceyi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Özellikle güzellik, uzunluk veya irilikte benzerlerini aşan olağanüstü varlığı niteler.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal, bir niteliğin olağan ölçüyü aşacak kadar ileri olmasını anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı farklı ölçeklere uygulanabilen son derece yapısıdır; komşu dal belirli görünür niteliklerde olağanüstü üstünlüğe bağlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; kalite, tamamlanma ve olağanüstü üstünlükle karışabilecek üç sınır seçildi.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, düşüncesizliği veya anlayış kıtlığı bulunmasına rağmen istediğini elde eden kişiyi anlatan sabit bir nitelemeyi açıkça destekler. Genel olarak hedefe ulaşmak ya da genel olarak düşüncesiz olmak bu özel birlikteliğin yerini tutmaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: İstenen sonuca ulaşma ile düşüncesizlik aynı kişide birlikte bulunmalıdır; dal bu kalıba özgüdür.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca düşüncesizliğine karşın istediğine ulaşan kişiyi belirten özel nitelemeyle sınırlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Düşüncesiz veya anlayışı kıt olduğu halde istediği sonuca ulaşabilen kişiyi niteleyen özel bir söz.

facets.statement: Kişide düşüncesizlik veya anlayış kıtlığı niteliği bulunur.
Aynı kişi bu niteliğine rağmen istediği sonucu elde eder.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, düşüncesizlik ile istenen sonucu elde etmenin beklenmedik biçimde aynı kişide birleştiği özel nitelemede uyuşur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnızca kişinin düşüncesizliği ile istediğini elde etmesi birlikte anlatıldığında kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Düşüncesizlik niteliğini ve buna rağmen hedefe erişme sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin anlayış kıtlığına rağmen amaçladığı sonuca ulaştığını açıklayan bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Olumsuz kişi niteliği ile başarılı sonucu aynı anda korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: düşüncesizliğine karşın istediğini elde eden kişi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sonuca ulaşan kişinin düşüncesiz veya anlayışı kıt olması zorunludur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kişinin aradığı ve amaçladığı şeyin son noktasına ulaşmasını herhangi bir kişi niteliği olmadan anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da kişinin istediği bir sonuca erişmesi vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı başarıyı düşüncesizlikle karşıtlık içinde veren özel bir nitelemedir; komşu yalnızca aranan sonuca ulaşmayı anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Düşüncesiz kişinin buna rağmen istediğini elde etmesi gerekir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yalnızca kişiyi anlayışsız veya akılsız olarak niteler; herhangi bir sonuç elde etme içermez.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kişiye düşüncesizlik veya anlayış kıtlığı yükler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal kişi niteliğinde durur; odak dalı aynı niteliğe beklenmedik başarı sonucunu zorunlu olarak ekler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sonucu elde eden kişinin düşüncesizliği nitelemenin kurucu parçasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Aranan nesneyi veya sonucu doğru biçimde bulup elde etme eylemini tek başına anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da amaçlanan veya aranan şeyin elde edilmesini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı kişi hakkında karşıtlık içeren bir yargıdır; komşu dal sonucun bulunmasına odaklanan yalın bir eylemdir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm adaylar incelendi; sonuca ulaşma, düşüncesizlik ve aradığını bulma bileşenlerini ayıran üç karşılaştırma yayımlandı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, binicinin atın koşusunu artırmak amacıyla dizgini tutan elini ileri uzatması biçimindeki özgül hareketi doğrudan verir. Anlam atın hızlı olması değil, binicinin hızı artırmaya yönelik dizgin hareketidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca binici, dizgin hareketi ve koşuyu artırma amacı birlikte bulunduğunda geçerlidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım biniciye bağlı at ve dizgin kalıbıyla sınırlıdır; genel koşma, hızlanma veya bir yere varma anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Binicinin, atın koşusunu hızlandırmak için dizgini tutan elini ileri uzatması.

facets.statement: Eylemi yapan binicidir ve hareket dizgini tutan elle gerçekleştirilir.
Elin ve dizginin ileri verilmesindeki amaç atın koşusunu artırmaktır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, binicinin dizgini tutan elini ileri vererek atın koşusunu artırmaya çalıştığı özgül binicilik hareketinde birleşir.

concept_gloss.text: atı hızlandırmak için dizgini ileri verme
concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnızca binicinin atın koşusunu artırma amacıyla yaptığı belirli dizgin hareketini temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Biniciyi, dizgin hareketini ve atı hızlandırma amacını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Binicinin atın koşusunu artırmak için elini ve dizgini ileri uzattığı sahnede kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Araç olan dizgini, binicinin hareketini ve hızlandırma amacını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: binicinin atı hızlandırmak için dizgini ileri vermesi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Koşuyu artırma isteği belirli bir el ve dizgin hareketiyle gerçekleştirilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Atı koşmaya yöneltme, dizgin hareketi olmadan da genel bir isteme eylemi olarak anlatılır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da kişi atın koşmasını veya daha hızlı koşmasını ister.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalının ayırt edici yanı dizgini tutan eli ileri uzatmaktır; komşu dal atın koşusunu istemeyi daha genel biçimde verir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Binicinin atı hızlandırmak amacıyla yaptığı dizgin hareketini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Atın, başka bir hayvanın veya binicinin gerçekleşmiş hızlı koşusunu ve yarışmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal atın koşusu ve hızının artması sahnesini paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı hızı doğurmaya yönelik binici hareketidir; komşu dal ise hayvanın veya binicinin hızlı koşma durumudur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dizgini ileri verme hareketinin amacı atın koşusunu artırmaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Binek hayvanının yürüyüşe yüklenmesini ve güçlü, hızlı koşma biçimini doğrudan anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal binek hayvanının hareketi ve hızlanması alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta binicinin araca yaptığı müdahale, komşuda ise hayvanın kendi yürüyüş veya koşu biçimi çekirdektir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; dizgin hareketini koşuyu isteme ve gerçekleşmiş hızlı koşudan ayıran üç ilişki seçildi.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, yokluğun veya hastalığın bir kimse üzerinde ağırlaşmasını belirli bir kalıp içinde anlatır. Bu, genel güçlük adı veya hastalığın kendisi değil, olumsuz durumun kişiyi giderek daha şiddetli biçimde sıkıştırmasıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yokluk ya da hastalığın belirli bir kişi üzerinde şiddetlenmesi kalıbıyla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca yokluk veya hastalığın bir kimse üzerinde ağırlaşmasını bildiren kalıba bağlanır.

concept_map.definition: Yokluğun veya hastalığın bir kimse üzerinde ağırlaşıp onu iyice sıkıştırması.

facets.statement: Olumsuz durum, belirli bir kimseyi etkileyerek önceki düzeyinden daha ağır hale gelir.
Ağırlaşan durum yokluk ya da hastalık olarak belirlenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, yokluk veya hastalığın belirli bir kişinin üzerinde şiddetlenip ağırlaşması biçimindeki kalıplaşmış kullanımda birleşir.

concept_gloss.text: yokluk veya hastalığın kişiyi iyice sıkıştırması
concept_gloss.applicability: Olumsuz durumun yalnızca bulunmasını değil, belirli kişi üzerinde ağırlaşmasını anlatan kalıba uygulanır.

error_profile.preserves: Yokluk veya hastalığı, etkilenen kişiyi ve şiddetlenme sürecini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yokluk ya da hastalığın belirli bir kişiyi giderek daha ağır biçimde etkilediği bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiye yönelen etkiyi ve durumun şiddetlenmesini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yokluğun veya hastalığın kişinin üzerinde ağırlaşması

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yokluk veya hastalığın belirli bir kişi üzerinde giderek ağırlaşmasını anlatan kalıba bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sıkıntı, daralma, ağrı ve maddi ya da bedensel güçlüğü genel adlar olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da kişi ağır bir sıkıntı veya bedensel zorluk yaşar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı durumun kişi üzerinde şiddetlenme sürecidir; komşu dal sıkıntı ve güçlüğün kendisini daha geniş biçimde adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Hastalığın kişi üzerinde daha da ağırlaşmasını anlatır ve yokluğu da kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sağlıklı ve dengeli durumdan çıkmayı, bedensel bozukluğu ve hastalık halini genel olarak tanımlar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Hastalık, iki dalın kesiştiği durum alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalında hastalık zaten vardır ve şiddetlenir; komşu dal hastalık durumunun kendisini ve sağlıktan sapmayı anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Şiddetin yokluk veya hastalık tarafından belirli kişiye yönelmesi gerekir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ağır darbe, ateşli hastalık, zarar ve genel güçlük gibi çok çeşitli şiddetli durumları kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da kişiyi zorlayan durumun şiddeti öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı iki belirli durumun ağırlaşma kalıbıdır; komşu dal farklı neden ve olaylardaki şiddeti geniş bir ad alanı olarak verir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm adaylar incelendi; şiddetlenme sürecini genel sıkıntıdan, hastalıktan ve geniş zarar alanından ayıran üç ilişki yayımlandı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, üzücü bir olayın benzerini yalnızca duymayı, fakat olayın konuşanların başına gelmemesini veya tamamlanmamasını dileyen kalıplaşmış sözü destekler. Bu anlam sıradan duyma ya da haber ulaştırma değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal üzücü olay karşısındaki korunma dileğiyle sınırlıdır; yalın işitme veya haber alma anlamına açılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kalıplaşmış korunma dileği dalın çekirdeğidir; üzücü haber adı ayrı bir sözlük birimi olarak tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Üzücü bir olayın benzerini yalnızca duymayı, onun konuşanların başına gelmemesini veya gerçekleşip tamamlanmamasını dileyen kalıplaşmış söz.

facets.statement: Konuşan, üzücü olayın benzerinden yalnızca uzaktan haber almayı kabul eder.
Aynı olayın kendilerine ulaşmaması veya gerçekleşip tamamlanmaması dilenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, üzücü olayın yalnızca duyulmasıyla bağlantılı kalıplaşmış korunma dileğini verir; bir yorum olayın konuşanların başına gelmemesini, diğer yorum ise işitilip tamamlanmamasını korur.

concept_gloss.text: üzücü olayı duyup ondan uzak kalmayı dileme

error_profile.preserves: Duyma ile olaydan korunma dileğini aynı kalıpta birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Üzücü bir olay duyulduğunda aynı durumun konuşanların başına gelmemesi dilenirken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Uzaktan duyma ile olaydan korunma karşıtlığını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: insanı üzen ve kendisine ulaşan haber

neighbor_distinctions.gloss: üzücü olayı duyup ondan uzak kalma dileği

Ancak haberden haberdar olma, öğretme, öğrenme ve bilgi bakımından üstün gelme kullanımları bu çekirdekle aynı düzeyde değil, belirli biçimlere bağlı uzantılar olarak tutulmalıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi bilme, tanıma ve gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavrama durumu bilgisizliğin karşıtıdır.
Bir haberin farkına varmak veya ondan haberdar olmak, bilme çekirdeğinin belirli bir konuya uygulanmasıdır.
Bildirme, öğretme ve öğrenme biçimleri bilginin bir başkasına ulaştırılması ya da kişinin onu edinmesi süreçlerini anlatır.
Karşılıklı bilgi sınamasında birini yenmek, belirli bir kuruluşta ortaya çıkan rekabetçi kullanımdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi başkasından ayıran belirgin izi dalın ortak çekirdeği olarak açıkça destekler. Bayrak, belirgin dağ, yol belirtisi, kumaş deseni ve savaş işareti gibi örnekler bu çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir; tanınmış kişi ve son zaman belirtisi ise benzetme veya gösterme ilişkisine bağlı uzantılardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bütün işaret türlerini sınırsızca kapsamaz; kaynakta anılan ayırt etme ve yol gösterme işlevli izlerle bunlara bağlı kullanımlarla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ayırt edici iz çıplak çekirdektir; savaşçı, kumaş, sarık ve belirli zaman göstergesiyle kurulan anlamlar kendi kuruluşlarına bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başkalarından ayıran, tanınmasını sağlayan veya ona götüren belirgin iz ya da işarettir. Bayrak, uzaktan seçilen dağ, yol belirtisi, kumaş kenarı ve sonradan konan tanıtıcı izler bu işlevin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi veya kişiyi başkalarından ayırıp tanınır kılan belirgin iz ya da işaret çekirdeği oluşturur.
Bayrak, belirgin dağ, yol belirtisi ve kumaşın kenar deseni yön bulduran veya tanıtan somut gerçekleşmelerdir.
Savaşçının, kumaşın veya sarığın ayırt edici bir işaretle donatılması belirli kuruluşlara bağlı eylemsel kullanımdır.
Tanınmış bir kişinin belirgin bir bayrağa benzetilmesi ve yaklaşan son zamanı gösteren belirti, işaret çekirdeğinin uzantılarıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ayırt edici izi ortak temel sayar ve bayrak, yüksek ya da belirgin dağ, yol göstergesi, kumaş kenarı, kına ve sonradan yerleştirilen tanıtıcı işaretleri bu temelde toplar. Tanınmış kişi ile yaklaşan son zamanın belirtisi de görünürlük ve gösterme işlevinden doğan uzantılardır.

error_profile.preserves: İşaretin sonradan konmasını ve ayırt etme amacını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Belirli bir son zamanın yaklaştığını haber veren gösterge bağlamına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Bir olayın yakınlığını gösterme işlevini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, bilerek konan bayrak ve işaretlerin yanı sıra yön bulduran belirgin dağ gibi göstergeleri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, geçmişte var olmuş veya gerçekleşmiş bir şeyden geriye kalan izi özellikle gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da görünür bir izin başka bir şeyi tanıtması veya ona kanıt olması bakımından örtüşür.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal doğal dağ işaretini, bayrağı, yol belirtisini ve kumaş kenarını da içine alan daha geniş bir gösterge alanına sahiptir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle atlara, varlıklara veya nesnelere tanıtma amacıyla işaret koyma eylemini öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir varlığı başkalarından ayıracak görünür bir işaretle tanıtmayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dalın çekirdeği işaretleme eylemine daha sıkı bağlıdır; odak dal ise konmuş işaretlerin yanında doğal kılavuzları ve bayrağı da adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal işaret koyma dışında bayrak, dağ, yol kılavuzu ve kumaş deseni gibi bağımsız adları da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, hayvana veya nesneye yakma, kesme ya da benzeri yolla bırakılan bedensel ve maddi damgayı gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal görünür bir belirti aracılığıyla tanıtma ve ayırt etme işlevini paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Damga bir yüzeye bilerek bırakılan fiziksel izdir; odak dalın işareti ise doğal veya yapılmış olabilir ve yön gösterme işlevi de taşıyabilir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: En yararlı karşılaştırmalar geçmişten kalan iz, bilerek konan tanıtıcı işaret ve fiziksel damga ile yapıldı; bayrak adayı yalnızca tek bir alt gerçekleşmeyi, öteki adaylar ise daha uzak renk veya biçim belirtilerini karşılar.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العلامة والعلم والراية والجبل والمعلم ومعالم الطريق والحدود وعلم الثوب ورقمه وتعليم الفارس والثوب والقدح والعمامة والحناء إذا جعلت علامة
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو إدراك العلم ولا اسم الخلق ولا شق الشفة العليا
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل صحيح واحد يدل على أثر بالشيء يتميز به عن غيره (maqayis)؛ العلامة وهي معروفة (maqayis)؛ العلم الراية والجمع أعلام (maqayis;sihah;tahdhib)؛ العلم الجبل الطويل والجميع الأعلام (ayn)؛ العلم الجبل (sihah;mufradat)؛ المعلم الأثر يستدل به على الطريق (sihah;tahdhib)؛ علم الثوب ورقمه في أطرافه (sihah;tahdhib;mufradat)؛ أعلم الفارس إذا كانت له علامة في الحرب (maqayis;sihah;tahdhib)؛ العلام الحناء (maqayis;sihah;tahdhib;mufradat)؛ علمت عمتي أعلمها علما (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, dalı yaratılmışların bütünü, gök düzeni ve içindekiler ya da yaratıkların ayrı sınıfları olarak açıklar. Her sınıfın ve bütünün yaratıcıyı gösteren bir belirti sayılması adlandırmanın gerekçesidir; bilme eylemi veya somut işaret dalıyla özdeş değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yaratılmış varlıkların bütünü veya sınıflarıyla sınırlıdır; bilme durumu ve bağımsız bir fiziksel işaret anlamına gelmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, çıplak dalın evren, yaratılmışların bütünü ve varlık sınıfları anlamlarını verir; başka kuruluşlardan anlam aktarmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yaratılmış olanların bütünü; bağlama göre evren ile içindekilerin tamamı veya yaratıkların ayrı ayrı sınıflarıdır. Bu bütünün yaratıcıyı gösteren bir belirti sayılması, adın açıklanan dayanağıdır.

facets.statement: Evren ve içindeki yaratılmış varlıkların tamamı tek bir bütün olarak adlandırılır.
Ad, yaratılmışların tamamı yanında onların her bir cinsini veya sınıfını ayrı bir bütün olarak da gösterebilir.
Yaratılmış bütünün kendi yaratıcısına gösterge olması, adlandırmanın açıklayıcı dayanağı olarak sunulur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu adı yaratılmışların bütünü için kullanır; kapsam bazen evren ve içindekilerin tamamı, bazen de yaratıkların her bir cinsi veya sınıfıdır. Bütünün kendi yaratıcısına işaret etmesi adlandırmayı açıklayan ortak bir düşüncedir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yaratılmış varlıkların tümünü tek bir düzen veya bütün olarak anlatan temel kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Evreni ve onun içindeki yaratılmışların bütününü birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün bütün evren yerine insan, görünmeyen varlıklar veya başka bir yaratık cinsi gibi ayrı sınıflara dağıtıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Her yaratık cinsinin ayrı bir bütün sayılması yönünü korur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların çoğu hayvan bedenindeki renk ve işaretleri ya da ilgisiz özel adları anlatır; aynı kökün bilme ve işaret dalları adlandırma gerekçesini açıklasa da bu dalın yaratılmışlar bütünü sınırını keskinleştirecek bir karşıtlık oluşturmaz.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العالم والعالمون بمعنى الخلق أو أصناف الخلائق أو كل جنس من الخلق لأنه معلم في نفسه ودال
